card.name: Week and weekly in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: The word week or weekly (and sometimes 'each' after a count) ending a frequency phrase such as 'days each week', 'every week', 'mg weekly', or 'three times weekly' in dosing or monitoring text.

modes.label: Per-week frequency
modes.description: Week or weekly completes a phrase giving how often something is given or done.

modes.label: Weekly after a dose or measure
modes.description: Weekly follows a dose amount or an adjective for repeated checks.
